items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Sissle; Interviewee responds 'Yeah' and later distinguishes Sissle and Blake as being 'doing their show' and 'weren't around in vaudeville' during the time the interviewee was active.

ctx.x: Sissle and Blake and Hank Jones were also on the show.
